stages.title: Setting out
stages.line: Travel light, come home, turn round, find company.
stages.why: Every journey starts by putting something down and finding who walks with you.

stages.title: Seeing others
stages.line: Right anger, the person at the gate, the wounded on the road.
stages.why: Once you have set out, the first thing that changes is what you notice.

stages.title: Love that comes first
stages.line: Loved before you earn it; asked, met with joy, free to question.
stages.why: Before anything is asked of you, you are loved. Everything else rests on that.

stages.title: Holding steady
stages.line: Making peace, keeping faith, opening the door.
stages.why: Now the road gets harder: provocation, pressure, strangers.

stages.title: Looking back on the road
stages.why: Like the friends at Emmaus, you see the road best when you look back on it.
